tasks.label: Start Frontend Detached
tasks.command: if lsof -i :5173 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Frontend already running on 5173'; else nohup npm run dev:frontend > .vscode/vite.log 2>&1 & echo $! > .vscode/vite.pid && echo 'Frontend started in background'; fi

tasks.label: Stop Frontend Detached
tasks.command: if [ -f .vscode/vite.pid ]; then kill $(cat .vscode/vite.pid) >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f .vscode/vite.pid; echo 'Frontend stopped'; else echo 'No frontend pid file'; fi
